privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: How Raadiso processes personal data under the GDPR and the Norwegian Personal Data Act.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body: The operator of this Raadiso installation is the data controller for the personal data processed on the platform.

data.title: What we process
data.body: Account data (e-mail, name, language), listings and messages you create, and security logs. We only collect what is needed to run the marketplace.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: We use one strictly necessary session cookie to keep you signed in. No tracking or advertising cookies are used, so no consent banner is needed.

ai.title: Automated decisions
ai.body: AI helps detect fraud and categorise listings. Personal data is redacted before it reaches a language model, every AI decision is logged, and uncertain decisions are reviewed by a human.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may request access to, correction, export or deletion of your data, and object to processing. You can also complain to Datatilsynet.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Data is kept only as long as needed: expired listings and security logs are deleted automatically according to our retention policies.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Contact the operator of this installation for privacy questions.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: The rules for using Raadiso. They are short on purpose: read them before you buy or sell.

service.title: The service
service.body: Raadiso is a marketplace where private people and businesses list items, property, cars and jobs, and contact each other. Raadiso is not a party to the deals made on it.

account.title: Your account
account.body: You need a confirmed e-mail address and must be at least 18 years old to create an account. Keep your password safe, and tell us if you think someone else has used your account. One person may verify one account with BankID.

listings.title: Listings
listings.body: Only list things you are allowed to sell, describe them honestly and set a real price. Illegal, stolen, counterfeit and dangerous goods are not allowed, and neither are listings that mislead or discriminate.

conduct.title: Contact between users
conduct.body: Use messages for the deal at hand. Spam, scams, harassment and asking for payment outside agreed methods are not allowed. Never share passwords or BankID codes with anyone.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.body: After a sale, buyer and seller may review each other once. Reviews must be honest and about the deal. Reviews that harass, threaten or contain personal data are removed.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.body: Moderators may remove listings, messages and reviews that break these terms, and suspend accounts. You are told when your listing is removed.

liability.title: Responsibility
liability.body: Buyers and sellers are responsible for their own deals. Check the item before you pay, and use the payment methods offered in the app.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: We tell you before these terms change. If you do not accept the new terms, you can delete your account.

welcome.title: Welcome to Raadiso
welcome.intro: Your account is ready. Three things that help, all optional:
welcome.languageHint: Raadiso is available in Norsk, English and Soomaali. Change it any time with the language menu at the top.
welcome.verifyHint: Buyers and sellers trust verified people more. Raadiso only stores that you are verified, never your national identity number.
welcome.passkeyHint: Log in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of a password. Safer against phishing, and faster.
